## Overview

This repository has **1 commit** reachable from all refs, and **HEAD has that same 1 commit**. All refs and HEAD name the same object: `d9722409cabd904e7339fda14fe1818d77be6641`. The only author identity is **Corpus fixture <fixture@example.invalid>** (1 commit).

## Where things live

The Git directory is `.git`. `HEAD` is a symbolic ref to `refs/heads/main`. That is the only ref file; there is no `packed-refs`. The object database is three loose objects and zero packs:

| Object | Type | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `d9722409cabd904e7339fda14fe1818d77be6641` | commit | the only commit |
| `7e476488da437541819d424ac7276cf48b3491a6` | tree | root tree of that commit |
| `8c1828de80f220d2d9d841f6d6380c29e1a9bc54` | blob | the file content in that tree |

The commit object stores this author header:

```
author Corpus fixture <fixture@example.invalid> 1793923200 +0000
committer Corpus fixture <fixture@example.invalid> 1793923200 +0000

Initial fixture
```

## How it works

`git rev-list --all` walks every ref under `refs/` plus `HEAD`. `git rev-list HEAD` walks only `HEAD`. Author counts use the raw author name and email on each commit (`%an <%ae>`), with mailmap disabled so identities stay as stored.

```text
$ git rev-parse HEAD
d9722409cabd904e7339fda14fe1818d77be6641

$ git symbolic-ref HEAD
refs/heads/main

$ git for-each-ref --format='%(objecttype) %(objectname) %(refname)'
commit d9722409cabd904e7339fda14fe1818d77be6641 refs/heads/main

$ git rev-list --all --count
1

$ git rev-list HEAD --count
1

$ git rev-list --all --not HEAD
(empty)

$ git rev-list HEAD --not --all
(empty)

$ git log --all --no-use-mailmap --format='%an <%ae>' | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr
   1 Corpus fixture <fixture@example.invalid>

$ git log --all --no-use-mailmap --format='%H%x09%an <%ae>'
d9722409cabd904e7339fda14fe1818d77be6641	Corpus fixture <fixture@example.invalid>
```

`git cat-file --batch-check --batch-all-objects` lists the three objects above. `git count-objects -v` reports `count: 3`, `in-pack: 0`, `packs: 0`. `git fsck --unreachable --no-reflogs --strict` prints nothing, so every object is reachable from the ref.

## Gotchas

Reflog entries exist for `HEAD` and `refs/heads/main`, and both point at the same commit (`commit (initial): Initial fixture`). They add no further commits. There is no `.mailmap` and no `mailmap` or `log.mailmap` config, so the single author line is the stored identity, with nothing folded together.
